index.title: The FDOrganizer
index.preIngestText: The tool can be used for data curation and organization before the data is transferred to a long-term archive
index.sourcesText: A variety of data sources, such as databases or electronic lab notebooks, can be connected to the FDOrganizer
index.archiveText: The data is automatically transferred to the connected long-term archive without any additional effort
index.import: Import research data from different source systems
index.importText: Research data can be imported easily from various connected data sources, such as electronic lab notebooks or databases
index.organizeText: The data can be organized and arranged in appropriate structures
index.metadataText: Metadata can be added and structured at different levels
index.edit1: Create data package and import the data from different sources
index.archive1: Agreement to the terms of use and definition of further requirements
index.reviewText: Review of the submitted data package by responsible parties
